metadata.name: Patron registration in steps
metadata.description: A new patron registers for a library card in three steps, each a myapp.step block over priv/fixtures/patron_registration_steps_screens.json. myapp.step is a returnable step, so a patron may go back from the card or the branch to the step before it, and finds what they gave there still filled in.

datamodel.description: What the steps collected, keyed by question key. Each myapp.step writes responses.<key> for the keys it names, from the press that finished it.
